MDN train #2146 scheduled to depart Fox Lake at 4:25 pm, will be delayed in departure due to an earlier mechanical failure and will express from Lake Forest to Western Avenue. Train #2148 will accommodate passengers at intermediate stops.

HC - Summit Station ADA Ramp Rehabilitation Project

Beginning Wednesday, September 16, the existing ADA ramp at the Summit Station will be temporarily out of service for rehabilitation and is expected to remain closed for approximately two months.  During this time, passengers using wheelchairs or requiring accessible access must use the existing ramp located at the southwest end of Platform 2 (inbound) to access boarding platforms.

BNSF Construction Extended Through September 23: Delays Expected of up to 30 Minutes; Trains #1296, #1300, #1289, and #1293 Canceled.

Updated 9/22: Commuters can expect delays of up to 30 minutes on September 22 and 23 due to ongoing tie construction. Trains #1296, #1300, #1289, and #1293 will not operate. Visit MetraTracker.com for train status.

MDN - Morton Grove Station Construction

Platform construction will take place at the Morton Grove station beginning Monday, August 3 through Spring 2027. Please allow additional travel time and use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

Milwaukee District North Ongoing Major Track Project Affecting Midday Service Sept. 9 - Oct 23

September 9 - October 23, ongoing track work to replace 4.5 miles of rail will affect midday service between Fox Lake and Round Lake. Passengers boarding at these stations should utilize alternate Metra lines or other transportation. Visit metra.com for more info.

RID - 115th St./Morgan Park Station Construction

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are now open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.
